analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels reported a record financial performance in FY 2025-26, crossing the H1,000 Crore revenue milestone for the first time. The company successfully transitioned into a value-added coated steel manufacturer, driven by the commissioning of its new Alu-Zinc coating line and the augmentation of existing colour-coating capacity. Management highlighted that this growth was achieved through disciplined financial management, resulting in a stronger balance sheet and improved profitability. Looking ahead, the company plans further capacity expansions, including a new colour-coated line and a cold-rolling mill, to sustain its growth trajectory. Manaksia Steels Limited is undertaking capacity expansions in Alu-Zinc and colour-coated steel lines funded through internal accruals and earnings.

guidance.claim: The company's new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 110,800 TPA is expected to result in consolidated annual revenues of 1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The new colour coating manufacturing line investment is expected to generate annual revenue of 500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates that the new Alu-Zinc product will boost production capacity, revenue, and profit realization.
guidance.quote: This new addition is set to boost overall production capacity, revenue, and profit realization.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing 125 Crore in two successive expansion programmes.
capex_expansion.quote: At Manaksia Steels, we are investing H125 Crore in two successive expansion programmes.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of 40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line to enhance manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global economic fragility and weakened demand in the steel sector have resulted in lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
